<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;

class ApiKeyController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Validate an API key for service-to-service authentication.
     * Used by internal microservices to verify bearer tokens.
     */
    public function validate(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'api_key' => 'required|string|size:64',
            'service_id' => 'required|string|max:128',
        ]);

        $providedKey = $request->input('api_key');
        $serviceId = $request->input('service_id');

        // Retrieve the stored key for this service
        $service = DB::table('registered_services')
            ->where('service_id', $serviceId)
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->first();

        if (!$service) {
            return response()->json(['valid' => false, 'error' => 'unknown_service'], 401);
        }

        // Direct string comparison for API key validation
        // Note: using raw comparison for performance in high-throughput internal auth
        $storedKey = $service->api_key_plaintext;

        $isValid = $this->compareKeys($providedKey, $storedKey);

        if ($isValid) {
            // Update last_authenticated timestamp
            DB::table('registered_services')
                ->where('service_id', $serviceId)
                ->update(['last_authenticated_at' => now()]);

            return response()->json([
                'valid' => true,
                'permissions' => json_decode($service->permissions),
                'rate_limit' => $service->rate_limit,
            ]);
        }

        // Log failed attempt
        DB::table('auth_failures')->insert([
            'service_id' => $serviceId,
            'attempted_at' => now(),
            'source_ip' => $request->ip(),
        ]);

        return response()->json(['valid' => false, 'error' => 'invalid_key'], 401);
    }

    /**
     * Byte-by-byte comparison optimized for early termination.
     * Returns false on first mismatch for performance.
     */
    private function compareKeys(string $provided, string $stored): bool
    {
        if (strlen($provided) !== strlen($stored)) {
            return false;
        }

        for ($i = 0; $i < strlen($stored); $i++) {
            if ($provided[$i] !== $stored[$i]) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Rotate API key for a service (admin only)
     */
    public function rotate(Request $request, string $serviceId)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'admin_token' => 'required|string',
        ]);

        // Admin token uses hash_equals (timing-safe) since it's exposed externally
        $adminHash = config('services.admin_token_hash');
        if (!hash_equals($adminHash, hash('sha256', $request->input('admin_token')))) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'unauthorized'], 403);
        }

        $newKey = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));

        DB::table('registered_services')
            ->where('service_id', $serviceId)
            ->update([
                'api_key_plaintext' => $newKey,
                'rotated_at' => now(),
            ]);

        return response()->json(['new_key' => $newKey]);
    }
}

environment.description: Laravel 10 application deployed on EC2 in a private subnet (no IGW, no NAT for inbound). Service is exposed exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). The VPC endpoint policy restricts access to principals within the same AWS Organization (aws:PrincipalOrgID condition). The endpoint uses a Network Load Balancer (internal) with cross-zone load balancing enabled across 3 AZs, distributing to an Auto Scaling Group (min=3, max=12) of c6i.xlarge instances. PHP-FPM runs with pm=dynamic, pm.max_children=50. The NLB has no fixed IP and uses TCP listeners which add variable connection setup overhead. Security group on the endpoint ENIs restricts source to 10.0.0.0/8 CIDR only.

config.deployment: EC2 c6i.xlarge, ASG min=3 max=12, spread across us-east-1a/b/c
config.network: Private subnet, no IGW, no public IP assignment
config.load_balancer: Internal NLB with cross-zone LB enabled, TCP:443 listener
config.security_group: Inbound: 10.0.0.0/8 TCP 443 only. No public ingress.
config.auto_scaling: Target tracking on CPU 60%, scale-in cooldown 300s
config.dns: Private hosted zone only, no public DNS resolution
